newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down, trade lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down, trade lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.50 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 509.36 from 511.90 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 877,008 dinars against 1.05 million dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.6 dinar to 19.4 dinars. Lease firm Tunisie Leasing dropped 0.5 dinar to 34.0 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air declined 0.4 dinar to 22.7 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF slid 0.4 dinar to 19 dinars. Amen Bank eased 0.36 dinar to 36.6 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was up 0.4 dinar to 38.4 dinars.
